snippet.title: Crosscountry USA for the Apple II [Part 01\02]
snippet.description:
Crosscountry USA is an edutainment game, you drive with your truck through the USA so you can learn more about the states and the cities.
But why do you drive through the USA? Well, you have deliver from one city to another.
While you drive you get hungry, run out of gas, get exhausted and the weather changes. This game has also a day\night cycle.

One of the better edutainment games. It's also always different.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s58b60sCBzg
